title: Cold-chain investigation review item, contract v1
description: One record value on coldchain.review-items, keyed by productId. Produced from gold/review_outbox (Outbox.ITEM is the enforcing implementation). Delivery is at least once: consumers deduplicate on deliveryId and apply an item to its case only when snapshotId is greater than the one the case holds. An item reports a change in a unit's assessment; it is never a release or recall decision.

deliveryId.description: SHA-256 of productId, snapshotId and assessmentHash ('removed' for a removed unit): one per assessment revision.

reviewItemId.description: The case this item updates: one per serialized unit (assessment scope PRODUCT_RETAINED_HISTORY).

snapshotId.description: The committed snapshot that assessed the unit; the item's revision.

previousSnapshotId.description: The snapshot of the assessment this item supersedes; absent for a unit not assessed before.

assessment.description: Absent when the unit was removed.

dataQualityFlags.description: Stored flags; flags derived as of a snapshot (STALE_INVENTORY) are not included.

lineageId.description: Checkpoint lineage of the publishing pipeline.

sourceRevisions.description: Evidence: the exact event revisions the assessment rests on (the last assessment's, for a removed unit). Intervals and segments are read by productId and snapshotId.
